assertions.description: RTCPeerConnection.prototype no longer has a createDTMFSender member (removed in Chrome 160; never shipped in Firefox or Safari).
The standard replacement surface exists: RTCRtpSender.prototype has a dtmf attribute.
RTCDTMFToneChangeEvent can be constructed and exposes the tone passed in its init dictionary.
A video RTCRtpSender's dtmf attribute is null (DTMF is audio-only), which is why the replacement needs no kind check.
assertions.test: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.getContext('2d').fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1); const t = c.captureStream().getVideoTracks()[0]; const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); try { return pc.addTrack(t).dtmf === null; } finally { pc.close(); t.stop(); } })()

assertions.description: Before negotiation an audio sender's dtmf.canInsertDTMF is false and insertDTMF() throws InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (() => { const ac = new AudioContext(); const t = ac.createMediaStreamDestination().stream.getAudioTracks()[0]; const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); const s = pc.addTrack(t); try { if (s.dtmf.canInsertDTMF !== false) return false; s.dtmf.insertDTMF('1'); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } finally { pc.close(); ac.close(); } })()

assertions.description: On a connected in-page loopback call, insertDTMF('1a') normalises the buffer to '1A' and fires tonechange for '1', 'A', then '' as the buffer drains.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ac = new AudioContext(); const d = ac.createMediaStreamDestination(); const a = new RTCPeerConnection(), b = new RTCPeerConnection(); a.onicecandidate = (e) => e.candidate && b.addIceCandidate(e.candidate); b.onicecandidate = (e) => e.candidate && a.addIceCandidate(e.candidate); const s = a.addTrack(d.stream.getAudioTracks()[0], d.stream); try { await a.setLocalDescription(); await b.setRemoteDescription(a.localDescription); await b.setLocalDescription(); await a.setRemoteDescription(b.localDescription); await new Promise((ok, no) => { const t0 = performance.now(); const tick = () => a.connectionState === 'connected' && s.dtmf.canInsertDTMF ? ok() : performance.now() - t0 > 8000 ? no(new Error('not connected')) : setTimeout(tick, 50); tick(); }); const seen = []; const done = new Promise((ok) => { s.dtmf.ontonechange = (e) => { seen.push(e.tone); if (e.tone === '') ok(); }; setTimeout(ok, 5000); }); s.dtmf.insertDTMF('1a', 40, 30); const buf = s.dtmf.toneBuffer; await done; return buf === '1A' && seen.join('|') === '1|A|'; } finally { a.close(); b.close(); ac.close(); } })()

assertions.description: On a connected sender, insertDTMF() with an unrecognized character ('E') throws InvalidCharacterError and leaves toneBuffer unchanged.
assertions.test: (async () => { const ac = new AudioContext(); const d = ac.createMediaStreamDestination(); const a = new RTCPeerConnection(), b = new RTCPeerConnection(); a.onicecandidate = (e) => e.candidate && b.addIceCandidate(e.candidate); b.onicecandidate = (e) => e.candidate && a.addIceCandidate(e.candidate); const s = a.addTrack(d.stream.getAudioTracks()[0], d.stream); try { await a.setLocalDescription(); await b.setRemoteDescription(a.localDescription); await b.setLocalDescription(); await a.setRemoteDescription(b.localDescription); await new Promise((ok, no) => { const t0 = performance.now(); const tick = () => a.connectionState === 'connected' && s.dtmf.canInsertDTMF ? ok() : performance.now() - t0 > 8000 ? no(new Error('not connected')) : setTimeout(tick, 50); tick(); }); try { s.dtmf.insertDTMF('1E'); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidCharacterError' && s.dtmf.toneBuffer === ''; } } finally { a.close(); b.close(); ac.close(); } })()
